'''Vellna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Vellna worked in the [[Gadrin]] wilderness outfitter shop [[Life Vines]], as an assistant to store's owner, [[Lowban Terlq]].
